key_themes: Hot August jobs report (162K vs 53K expected) sparks rate-hike bets, yields jump
Tech earnings bifurcated: Snowflake and DocuSign beat big, Guidewire and Lululemon crush guidance
Credit bureau sector rocked by FHFA Director Pulte's regulatory threat to tri-merge standard
Tesla Cybercab faces NHTSA safety investigation one day after Austin commercial launch

stocks.reason: Surged 22%+ in after-hours/premarket after Q2 FY26 earnings crushed estimates: EPS $0.62 vs $0.45 expected, revenue $1.55B vs $1.48B; product revenue +37% YoY driven by AI products (CoCo, CoWork); full-year guidance raised to $6.07B
Plunged 22% after Q1 FY2027 revenue guidance of $372-378M midpoint missed consensus by ~3.3%, and ARR outlook disappointed, overshadowing a Q4 FY26 earnings beat ($0.99 EPS vs $0.93 expected)

Fell 17-18% after slashing full-year revenue guidance to $10.35-10.5B (a 5-7% decline); Q2 revenue fell 4% YoY to $2.42B, missing estimates; global comparable sales down ~10%; incoming CEO faces prolonged turnaround

Dropped 6% after NHTSA opened investigation into whether the Cybercab was properly self-certified under Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards, and Thursday's Austin launch event underwhelmed — CEO Musk absent, not streamed; Wells Fargo titled note "TSLA Cybercab Launch Event Underwhelms"

Plunged 21% after FHFA Director Bill Pulte ordered Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to approve VantageScore 4.0 while accusing credit bureaus of "cartel-like" practices and threatening a bi-merge approach that could eliminate one bureau from mortgage pulls

Fell sharply alongside FICO and TransUnion on FHFA Director Pulte's directive and threat to the lucrative tri-merge credit reporting standard; Pulte accused bureaus of "overcharging Americans for far too long"
Declined in tandem with EFX and FICO on FHFA Director Pulte's credit bureau regulatory offensive, threatening mandatory bi-merge mortgage credit pulls that would cut a bureau out of the process
Rose 8%+ as the semiconductor sector broadly rallied heading into the long weekend; chip stocks led by Sandisk outperformed the weak tape

Gained 6.5% after CEO Adam Aron publicly condemned Robinhood's tokenized stock products for AMC, calling the practice "contemptible, outrageous, disgusting," generating significant retail investor attention
Showed unusual call options activity (6x average daily volume, 3:1 calls vs puts) with traders targeting the Sept 4 $120 call; shares rose ~4% alongside a Bitcoin price bump
Beat Q2 adjusted earnings and revenue estimates reported after Sept 3 close; raised full-year revenue and non-GAAP operating margin guidance, stock moved higher on strong results

Downgraded by Canaccord Genuity to Hold from Buy (target $17, up from $15) citing the stock's recent rally and a competitive environment described as "only getting more fluid" from AI automation pressure
Downgraded to Hold from Buy at Craig-Hallum with price target slashed to $70 from $95, a significant 26% cut to the target, weighing on the stock
Upgraded to Overweight from Equal Weight at Morgan Stanley with a significant 25% price target hike to $101.30 from $81.60, among the most notable energy analyst calls of the day

Q3 FY26 results (reported Sept 2) showed adjusted EPS $1.11 vs $0.95 expected and revenue $12.21B vs consensus; record revenue driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure servers; stock continued to trade on this beat
